title: Lahaina tree program fruit forest with county parks
summary: The tree recovery program is planning a fruit forest in partnership with the county parks department, which the chair called a partnership with Maui County. It is meant to give the community more fruit and food, mainly for the people, with scions (cuttings) used to grow more trees. The chair will invite members to visit once ground is broken on the parcel.
